src_text: - Identify the macronutrients needed by prokaryotes, and explain their importance

src_text: - Describe the roles of prokaryotes in the carbon and nitrogen cycles

src_text: Prokaryotes have been able to live in every environment by using whatever energy and carbon sources are available.
tgt_text: Prokaryotlar har qanday energiya va uglerod manbalaridan foydalanib, har qanday muhitda yashashga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

src_text: The diverse environments and ecosystems on Earth have a wide range of conditions in terms of temperature, available nutrients, acidity, salinity, and energy sources.
tgt_text: Yerdagi turli xil muhitlar va ekotizimlar harorat, mavjud ozuqa moddalari, kislotalilik, sho'rlanish va energiya manbalari nuqtai nazaridan keng sharoitlarga ega.

src_text: Prokaryotes are very well equipped to make their living out of a vast array of nutrients and conditions.
tgt_text: Prokaryotlar juda ko'p miqdorda ozuqa moddalari va sharoitlardan foydalanish uchun juda yaxshi jihozlangan.

src_text: Recall that macromolecules are produced by the polymerization of smaller units called monomers.
tgt_text: Eslatib o'tamiz, makromolekulalar monomerlar deb ataladigan kichikroq birliklarning polimerizatsiyasi natijasida hosil bo'ladi.

src_text: When prokaryotes grow in nature, they obtain their nutrients from the environment.
tgt_text: Prokaryotlar tabiatda o'sganda, ular oziq moddalarini atrof muhitdan oladi.

src_text: Nutrients that are required in large amounts are called macronutrients, whereas those required in smaller or trace amounts are called micronutrients.
tgt_text: Ko'p miqdorda zarur bo'lgan ozuqa moddalariga makronutrientlar deyiladi, ozroq yoki oz miqdorda talab qilinadiganlarga esa mikroelementlar deyiladi.

src_text: They are the components of organic compounds in cells, including water.
tgt_text: Ular hujayralardagi organik birikmalarning, shu jumladan suvning tarkibiy qismlari.

src_text: Carbon is the major element in all macromolecules: carbohydrates, proteins, nucleic acids, lipids, and many other compounds.
tgt_text: Uglerod barcha makromolekulalarning asosiy elementidir: uglevodlar, oqsillar, nuklein kislotalar, lipidlar va boshqa ko'plab birikmalar.

src_text: Most of the nitrogen available in nature is either atmospheric nitrogen (N2) or another inorganic form.
tgt_text: Tabiatda mavjud bo'lgan azotning ko'p qismi atmosfera azotidir (N.2) yoki boshqa noorganik shakl.

src_text: Other important macronutrients are potassium (K), magnesium (Mg), calcium (Ca), and sodium (Na).
tgt_text: Boshqa muhim makroelementlar - kaliy (K), magniy (Mg), kaltsiy (Ca) va natriy (Na).

src_text: In addition to these macronutrients, prokaryotes require various metallic elements in small amounts.
tgt_text: Bu makroelementlarga qo'shimcha ravishda, prokaryotlar oz miqdordagi har xil metall elementlarni talab qiladi.

src_text: These are referred to as micronutrients or trace elements.
tgt_text: Ularga mikroelementlar yoki iz elementlari deyiladi.

src_text: For example, iron is necessary for the function of the cytochromes involved in electron-transport reactions.
tgt_text: Masalan, temir elektron-transport reaktsiyalarida ishtirok etadigan sitoxromlarning ishlashi uchun zarurdir.

src_text: Some prokaryotes require other elements—such as boron (B), chromium (Cr), and manganese (Mn)—primarily as enzyme cofactors.
tgt_text: Ba'zi prokaryotlarga boshqa elementlar kerak bo'ladi, masalan, bor (B), xrom (Cr) va marganets (Mn) - asosan ferment kofaktorlari.

src_text: Prokaryotes can use different sources of energy to assemble macromolecules from smaller molecules.
tgt_text: Prokaryotlar kichik molekulalardan makromolekulalarni yig'ish uchun turli energiya manbalaridan foydalanishi mumkin.

src_text: Those that can also use inorganic compounds as energy sources are called chemolitotrophs.
tgt_text: Energiya manbalari sifatida noorganik birikmalardan ham foydalanishi mumkin bo'lganlar xemolitotroflar deb ataladi.

src_text: Prokaryotes not only can use different sources of energy but also different sources of carbon compounds.
tgt_text: Prokaryotlar nafaqat turli xil energiya manbalaridan, balki uglerod birikmalarining turli manbalaridan ham foydalanishlari mumkin.

src_text: Autotrophic prokaryotes synthesize organic molecules from carbon dioxide.
tgt_text: Avtotrofik prokaryotlar karbonat angidriddan organik molekulalarni sintez qiladi.

src_text: To make the picture more complex, the terms that describe how prokaryotes obtain energy and carbon can be combined.
tgt_text: Rasmni murakkabroq qilish uchun prokaryotlarning energiya va uglerodni qanday olishini tavsiflovchi atamalarni birlashtirish mumkin.

src_text: Thus, photoautotrophs use energy from sunlight, and carbon from carbon dioxide and water, whereas chemoheterotrophs obtain energy and carbon from an organic chemical source.
tgt_text: Shunday qilib, fotoavtotroflar energiyani quyosh nuridan, uglerodni esa karbonat angidrid va suvdan ishlatadilar, kimyoheterotroflar esa organik kimyoviy manbadan energiya va uglerod oladi.

src_text: Chemolitoautotrophs obtain their energy from inorganic compounds, and they build their complex molecules from carbon dioxide.
tgt_text: Chemolitoautotroflar o'z energiyasini noorganik birikmalardan oladi va ular murakkab molekulalarini karbonat angidriddan hosil qiladi.

src_text: Prokaryotes are ubiquitous: There is no niche or ecosystem in which they are not present.
tgt_text: Prokaryotlar hamma joyda uchraydi: ular bo'lmagan joy yoki ekotizim yo'q.

src_text: Prokaryotes play many roles in the environments they occupy.
tgt_text: Prokaryotlar o'zlari egallagan muhitda ko'p rol o'ynaydi.

src_text: The movement of carbon is via carbon dioxide, which is removed from the atmosphere by land plants and marine prokaryotes, and is returned to the atmosphere via the respiration of chemoorganotrophic organisms, including prokaryotes, fungi, and animals.
tgt_text: Uglerodning harakati uglerod dioksidi orqali amalga oshiriladi, u quruqlikdagi o'simliklar va dengiz prokaryotlari tomonidan atmosferadan chiqariladi va kimyoviy organotrof organizmlar, shu jumladan prokariotlar, zamburug'lar va hayvonlarning nafas olishi orqali atmosferaga qaytariladi.

src_text: Consumers such as animals use organic compounds generated by producers and release carbon dioxide to the atmosphere.
tgt_text: Hayvonlar kabi iste'molchilar ishlab chiqaruvchilar tomonidan ishlab chiqarilgan organik birikmalardan foydalanadilar va atmosferaga karbonat angidridni chiqaradilar.

src_text: In anoxic sediments, prokaryotes, mostly archaea, produce methane (CH4).
tgt_text: Anoksik cho'kindilarda prokaryotlar, asosan, arxeylar metan hosil qiladi (CH4).

src_text: In other words, a cell is the simplest functional unit of a life.
tgt_text: Boshqacha qilib aytganda, hujayra - hayotning eng oddiy funktsional birligi.

src_text: The cells of microorganisms like bacteria, protozoa, and fungi are bound by cell membranes and use them to interact with the environment.
tgt_text: Bakteriyalar, protozoa va zamburug'lar kabi mikroorganizmlarning hujayralari hujayra membranalari bilan bog'langan va ularni atrof-muhit bilan o'zaro ta'sir qilish uchun ishlatadi.

src_text: Cell Structure and Function
tgt_text: Hujayra tuzilishi va funktsiyasi

src_text: Prokaryotic and Eukaryotic Cells Revisited
tgt_text: Prokaryotik va eukaryotik hujayralar qayta ko'rib chiqildi

src_text: Now that you have an idea of how cells are constructed, we can look at the great diversity of the kinds of cells that exist.
tgt_text: Endi siz hujayralar qanday tuzilganligi haqida tasavvurga ega bo'lsangiz, biz mavjud hujayralar turlarining xilma -xilligini ko'rib chiqishimiz mumkin.

src_text: You already know that there are significant differences between prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells.
tgt_text: Siz allaqachon bilasizki, prokaryotik va eukaryotik hujayralar o'rtasida sezilarli farqlar bor.

src_text: Thus, biologists have classified organisms into three large categories, called domains.
tgt_text: Shunday qilib, biologlar organizmlarni domenlar deb ataladigan uchta katta toifaga ajratdilar.

src_text: The Domain Archaea contains many kinds of microorganisms that have significant biochemical differences from the Bacteria.
tgt_text: Archaea domenida ko'p turdagi mikroorganizmlar mavjud bo'lib, ular bakteriyalardan sezilarli biokimyoviy farqlarga ega.

src_text: Many of the Archaea have special metabolic abilities and live in extreme environments of high temperature or extreme saltiness.
tgt_text: Arxeylarning ko'pchiligi maxsus metabolik qobiliyatga ega va yuqori harorat yoki haddan tashqari sho'r muhitda yashaydi.

src_text: Although only a few thousand Bacteria and only about 200 Archaea have been described, recent DNA studies of seawater and soil suggest that there are millions of undescribed species.
tgt_text: Garchi bir necha ming bakteriya va atigi 200 ga yaqin arxey tasvirlangan bo'lsa-da, dengiz suvi va tuproqning yaqinda o'tkazilgan DNK tadqiqotlari millionlab ta'riflanmagan turlar mavjudligini ko'rsatmoqda.

src_text: All other living things are comprised of eukaryotic cells.
tgt_text: Boshqa barcha tirik mavjudotlar eukaryotik hujayralardan iborat.

src_text: However, prokaryotic cells contain DNA and enzymes and are able to reproduce and engage in metabolism.
tgt_text: Biroq, prokaryotik hujayralar DNK va fermentlarni o'z ichiga oladi va ko'payish va metabolizm bilan shug'ullanishga qodir.

src_text: They perform all of the basic functions of living things with fewer and simpler organelles.
tgt_text: Ular tirik organizmlarning barcha asosiy funktsiyalarini kamroq va oddiy organellalar bilan bajaradilar.

src_text: Although some Eubacteria have a type of green photosynthetic pigment and carry on photosynthesis, they do so without chloroplasts and use somewhat different chemical reactions.
tgt_text: Garchi ba'zi Eubakteriyalar yashil rangli fotosintetik pigmentga ega bo'lsa-da va fotosintezni davom ettirsalar ham, ular buni xloroplastlarsiz amalga oshiradilar va biroz boshqacha kimyoviy reaktsiyalardan foydalanadilar.

src_text: In certain bacteria, this layer is responsible for their ability to stick to surfaces, forming biofilms (e.g., the film of bacteria on teeth), and to resist phagocytosis.
tgt_text: Ba'zi bakteriyalarda bu qatlam ularning sirtga yopishib, biofilmlar (masalan, tishlar ustidagi bakteriyalar plyonkasi) hosil qilish va fagotsitozga qarshi turish qobiliyati uchun javobgardir.

src_text: Below the capsule is the rigid cell wall, comprised of a unique protein/carbohydrate complex called peptidoglycan.
tgt_text: Kapsül ostida peptidoglikan deb ataladigan noyob protein/uglevod kompleksidan iborat qattiq hujayra devori joylashgan.

src_text: This gives the cell the strength to resist osmotic pressure changes and gives it shape.
tgt_text: Bu hujayraga osmotik bosim o'zgarishlariga qarshilik ko'rsatish kuchini beradi va shakl beradi.

src_text: Just beneath the wall is the plasma membrane.
tgt_text: Devor ostida plazma membranasi joylashgan.

src_text: Thinner and with a slightly different chemical composition from that of eukaryotes, the plasma membrane carries out the same functions as the plasma membrane in eukaryotes.
tgt_text: Yupqaroq va kimyoviy tarkibi eukaryotlardan bir oz boshqacha bo'lsa, plazma membranasi eukaryotlarda plazma membranasi kabi vazifalarni bajaradi.

src_text: The genetic material within the cytoplasm is DNA in the form of a loop.
tgt_text: Sitoplazmadagi genetik material - bu halqa shaklidagi DNK.

src_text: Many have a rod or spherical shape, although some are square or triangular.
tgt_text: Ko'pchilik novda yoki sharsimon shaklga ega, garchi ba'zilari kvadrat yoki uchburchak bo'lsa.

src_text: Some have flagella and have cell walls, but the cell walls are made of a different material than that of bacteria.
tgt_text: Ba'zilarida flagella va hujayra devorlari bor, ammo hujayra devorlari bakteriyalarnikidan farqli materialdan iborat.

src_text: This discovery was important to medicine, because many cellular forms of life that cause common diseases are bacterial.
tgt_text: Bu kashfiyot tibbiyot uchun juda muhim edi, chunki umumiy kasalliklarga sabab bo'ladigan ko'plab uyali hayot shakllari bakterialdir.

src_text: As soon as differences in the ribosomes were noted, researchers began to look for ways in which to interfere with the bacterial ribosome’s function, but not interfere with the ribosomes of eukaryotic cells.
tgt_text: Ribosomalardagi farqlar qayd etilgach, tadqiqotchilar bakterial ribosoma funktsiyasiga, lekin eukaryotik hujayralar ribosomalariga aralashmaslik usullarini izlay boshladilar.

src_text: Because eukaryotic ribosomes differ from bacterial ribosomes, streptomycin does not interfere with the normal function of the ribosomes in human cells.
tgt_text: Eukaryotik ribosomalar bakterial ribosomalardan farq qilganligi uchun streptomitsin inson hujayralarida ribosomalarning normal ishlashiga to'sqinlik qilmaydi.

src_text: Eukaryotic organisms can be further divided into several categories, based on the specific combination of organelles they contain.
tgt_text: Eukaryotik organizmlarni o'z ichiga olgan organellalarning o'ziga xos birikmasiga qarab bir necha toifalarga bo'lish mumkin.

src_text: The cells of plants, fungi, protozoa and algae, and animals are all eukaryotic.
tgt_text: O'simliklar, qo'ziqorinlar, protozoyalar va suv o'tlari va hayvonlarning hujayralari hammasi eukaryotikdir.

src_text: The most obvious characteristic that sets plants and algae apart from other organisms is their green color, which indicates that the cells contain chlorophyll in chloroplasts.
tgt_text: O'simliklar va yosunlarni boshqa organizmlardan ajratib turadigan eng aniq xususiyat ularning yashil rangidir, bu hujayralarda xloroplastlarda xlorofill borligini ko'rsatadi.

src_text: Chlorophyll is necessary for photosynthesis—the conversion of light energy into chemical-bond energy in food molecules.
tgt_text: Xlorofil fotosintez uchun zarurdir-yorug'lik energiyasini oziq-ovqat molekulalarida kimyoviy bog'lanish energiyasiga aylantirish.

src_text: Organisms that belong in this category of eukaryotic cells include yeasts, molds, mushrooms, and the fungi that cause such human diseases as athlete’s foot, jungle rot, and ringworm.
tgt_text: Eukaryotik hujayralarning ushbu toifasiga mansub organizmlarga xamirturushlar, mog'orlar, qo'ziqorinlar va oyoq, o'rmon chirishi va ringworm kabi inson kasalliklarini keltirib chiqaradigan qo'ziqorinlar kiradi.

src_text: Eukaryotic organisms that lack cell walls and chloroplasts are placed in separate groups.
tgt_text: Hujayra devorlari va xloroplastlari bo'lmagan eukaryotik organizmlar alohida guruhlarga joylashtirilgan.

src_text: Note: Viruses are not included in this classification system, because viruses are not composed of the basic cellular structural components.
tgt_text: Eslatma: Viruslar ushbu tasnif tizimiga kiritilmagan, chunki viruslar asosiy hujayra tarkibiy qismlaridan iborat emas.

src_text: Although the differences in these groups of organisms may seem to set them worlds apart, their similarity in cellular structure is one of the central themes unifying the field of biology.
tgt_text: Ushbu organizmlar guruhlaridagi farqlar ularni bir-biridan ajratib tursa-da, ularning hujayra tuzilishidagi o'xshashligi biologiya sohasini birlashtiruvchi asosiy mavzulardan biridir.

src_text: Because the organelles have the same general structure and function, regardless of the kind of cell in which they are found, we can learn more about how mitochondria function in plants by studying how mitochondria function in animals.
tgt_text: Organoidlarning umumiy tuzilishi va funktsiyalari bir xil bo'lgani uchun, ular qanday hujayrada bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, hayvonlarda mitoxondriya qanday ishlashini o'rganish orqali o'simliklarda mitoxondriya qanday ishlashi haqida ko'proq bilib olishimiz mumkin.

src_text: Prokaryotlar har qanday energiya va uglerod manbalaridan foydalanib, har qanday muhitda yashashga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
tgt_text: Prokaryotes have been able to live in every environment by using whatever energy and carbon sources are available.

src_text: Yerdagi turli xil muhitlar va ekotizimlar harorat, mavjud ozuqa moddalari, kislotalilik, sho'rlanish va energiya manbalari nuqtai nazaridan keng sharoitlarga ega.
tgt_text: The diverse environments and ecosystems on Earth have a wide range of conditions in terms of temperature, available nutrients, acidity, salinity, and energy sources.

src_text: Prokaryotlar juda ko'p miqdorda ozuqa moddalari va sharoitlardan foydalanish uchun juda yaxshi jihozlangan.
tgt_text: Prokaryotes are very well equipped to make their living out of a vast array of nutrients and conditions.

src_text: Eslatib o'tamiz, makromolekulalar monomerlar deb ataladigan kichikroq birliklarning polimerizatsiyasi natijasida hosil bo'ladi.
tgt_text: Recall that macromolecules are produced by the polymerization of smaller units called monomers.

src_text: Prokaryotlar tabiatda o'sganda, ular oziq moddalarini atrof muhitdan oladi.
tgt_text: When prokaryotes grow in nature, they obtain their nutrients from the environment.

src_text: Ko'p miqdorda zarur bo'lgan ozuqa moddalariga makronutrientlar deyiladi, ozroq yoki oz miqdorda talab qilinadiganlarga esa mikroelementlar deyiladi.
tgt_text: Nutrients that are required in large amounts are called macronutrients, whereas those required in smaller or trace amounts are called micronutrients.

src_text: Ular hujayralardagi organik birikmalarning, shu jumladan suvning tarkibiy qismlari.
tgt_text: They are the components of organic compounds in cells, including water.

src_text: Uglerod barcha makromolekulalarning asosiy elementidir: uglevodlar, oqsillar, nuklein kislotalar, lipidlar va boshqa ko'plab birikmalar.
tgt_text: Carbon is the major element in all macromolecules: carbohydrates, proteins, nucleic acids, lipids, and many other compounds.

src_text: Tabiatda mavjud bo'lgan azotning ko'p qismi atmosfera azotidir (N.2) yoki boshqa noorganik shakl.
tgt_text: Most of the nitrogen available in nature is either atmospheric nitrogen (N2) or another inorganic form.

src_text: Boshqa muhim makroelementlar - kaliy (K), magniy (Mg), kaltsiy (Ca) va natriy (Na).
tgt_text: Other important macronutrients are potassium (K), magnesium (Mg), calcium (Ca), and sodium (Na).

src_text: Bu makroelementlarga qo'shimcha ravishda, prokaryotlar oz miqdordagi har xil metall elementlarni talab qiladi.
tgt_text: In addition to these macronutrients, prokaryotes require various metallic elements in small amounts.

src_text: Ularga mikroelementlar yoki iz elementlari deyiladi.
tgt_text: These are referred to as micronutrients or trace elements.

src_text: Masalan, temir elektron-transport reaktsiyalarida ishtirok etadigan sitoxromlarning ishlashi uchun zarurdir.

src_text: Ba'zi prokaryotlarga boshqa elementlar kerak bo'ladi, masalan, bor (B), xrom (Cr) va marganets (Mn) - asosan ferment kofaktorlari.
tgt_text: Some prokaryotes require other elements—such as boron (B), chromium (Cr), and manganese (Mn)—primarily as enzyme cofactors.

src_text: Energiya manbalari sifatida noorganik birikmalardan ham foydalanishi mumkin bo'lganlar xemolitotroflar deb ataladi.

src_text: Prokaryotlar nafaqat turli xil energiya manbalaridan, balki uglerod birikmalarining turli manbalaridan ham foydalanishlari mumkin.

src_text: Avtotrofik prokaryotlar karbonat angidriddan organik molekulalarni sintez qiladi.
tgt_text: Autotrophic prokaryotes synthesize organic molecules from carbon dioxide.

src_text: Rasmni murakkabroq qilish uchun prokaryotlarning energiya va uglerodni qanday olishini tavsiflovchi atamalarni birlashtirish mumkin.
tgt_text: To make the picture more complex, the terms that describe how prokaryotes obtain energy and carbon can be combined.

src_text: Chemolitoautotroflar o'z energiyasini noorganik birikmalardan oladi va ular murakkab molekulalarini karbonat angidriddan hosil qiladi.
